evaluation_components.when: Announced 4 tests - best 3 will be considered for the final marks

attendance_policy: Each student is expected to attend all classes and participate in all evaluation components.
makeup_policy: Make-up will be granted for any missing evaluative components due to genuine reasons. For a comprehensive examination, the request should be made to AUGSD in accordance with its guidelines. The decision to grant make-up to the applicant will be decided by the course instructor.
